minutes.headline: Board recommended the turf and track replacement and school building transfers, and chose a 15-year road debt scenario for Town Meeting.
minutes.summary: Ahead of annual town meeting, the board went through warrant articles. It heard a yard-waste pickup proposal, a Summer Street easement update, and a heated discussion of the water district study committee article. It then reviewed the turf field and cell tower articles, the transfer of two school buildings, the FY16 budget adjustment, the solid waste budget and road financing, and accepted a ZBA resignation.

what_happened.line: The Select Board chose financing scenario 1.1 for the road debt exclusion to put before Town Meeting.
The board recommended the turf field and cell tower lease articles, 27 and 28, by a vote with one opposed; the Board of Selectmen replaces the Parks Commission as lease signer.
The board recommended articles 30 and 31, transferring the Brooks House and TC Passios buildings to the Selectmen.
The board also recommended the FY2016 budget adjustment (article 9) and the solid waste enterprise fund budget (article 18).
The yard waste petitioner agreed to rework article 44 into a non-binding straw poll at Town Meeting, followed by a survey.

why_it_matters: The road financing choice sets how a debt exclusion for paving would be borrowed, which would appear as an added line on property tax bills if voters approve it.

The turf and cell tower articles decide how replacement of the field is paid for, and the building transfers decide who runs two town-linked buildings and how their costs are covered, mostly by rents or by the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: Annual Town Meeting votes on the warrant articles, including 9, 18, 26, 27, 28, 30, 31, 44 and 45.
The yard waste straw poll at Town Meeting and the survey that follows it.
